broadcast.text: D1LLIGAF back at 98 with a full starting lineup already locked. Everything from here is gravy on gravy.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: Gadsden, Dowdle, Meyers, and Dobbins close out the run — Meyers third string on his own depth chart, this is deep-bench territory now.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Alec Pierce comes off the board at 88 — he's on the PUP list. A real gamble for whoever's stashing him.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Lemon, Washington, Stevenson, and Wilson round out the next few — all carrying depth-chart flags, pure bench lottery tickets at this point.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Last good one, and it's ours. Feels like the tenth time we've said that today.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: D1LLIGAF takes Sam LaPorta at 9.03 — last tight end before the cliff, and the starting lineup is basically complete.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: D1LLIGAF up at 83 with the TE slot still empty — that's the one hole left on this roster.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: A BOT took him. Not us. I can breathe again. Some things this war room simply does not do.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: And then a bot takes Dak Prescott at 82 — right around consensus for a QB1 this deep.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Kraft, Metcalf, Sutton go next — Kraft still Questionable, all three roughly on their numbers.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Sensible AND correct. This roster doesn't have a bad pick in it, I've checked.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: D1LLIGAF grabs Tony Pollard at 8.08 — insurance behind a 31-year-old Henry, sensible depth move.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Still not over the McLaurin pick. D1LLIGAF on the clock again at 78 — riding the high.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: Pitts, Watson, Tate, Tyson, and Thomas fill in around them — mostly bench dice rolls this deep, Tyson carrying both a rookie and depth-chart flag.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Composing yourself over there? We've got a QB flurry to call — Burrow, Hurts, Dart, and Caleb Williams all off the board in this stretch. Four quarterbacks in eight picks.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: A COMMANDER. In OUR locker room. I need a minute. This is the pick of the draft, I don't care what the tiers say from here on out.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: D1LLIGAF takes Terry McLaurin at 7.03 — fifteen ranks of pure value sitting on the board at pick 63.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: D1LLIGAF up again at 63 with a Henry-Swift backfield already banked. Whatever comes next is just gravy.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: Jayden Daniels off at 60, RJ Harvey at 61 with his own depth-chart flag, Rome Odunze at 62 — bench-and-hope territory for all three.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Mike Evans goes at 59 still Questionable — another team betting the injury report clears in time.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: 'Last startable back' and D1LLIGAF's the one who got him. The rest of the room can pick through the scraps now.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: Fannin goes at 57, then D1LLIGAF secures D'Andre Swift at 6.08 — RB2 finally locked in, last startable back on the board by our tiers.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: One more pick and D1LLIGAF's back at 58 with a Maye-shaped head start on every other QB room at the table.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: Tuten, Montgomery, and Judkins keep the RB bench-depth run going, DJ Moore closes it at 56 — nothing here threatens the top of anyone's roster.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: TreVeyon Henderson, Tyler Warren, Davante Adams — Adams still carrying his own depth-chart flag — round out the middle of this stretch.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Jameson Williams and Loveland go next, then Lamar finally comes off the board at 49 — a full round behind where D1LLIGAF found his QB1.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: A hair over Lamar and everyone else waited. That's not a reach, that's everyone else asleep at the wheel.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: D1LLIGAF takes Drake Maye at 5.03 — first QB of the draft for him, and the board actually likes Maye a hair over Lamar Jackson.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Snake turns right back to D1LLIGAF at 43. Three WRs and Henry through four rounds — time to see if he balances it out or doubles down.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: Javonte Williams to close the batch at 42 — DAL still finding takers, RB pool scraping the bottom of tier three.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: McMillan, Flowers, and Egbuka all follow at 39 through 41 — Flowers with his own injury question mark. Receiver depth is getting picked clean fast.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Fair, though the flag's the flag regardless of whose team it's on.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Third receiver means third guy who can catch a football. Anchor's been quiet about every other Questionable tag today — funny how that works.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: D1LLIGAF takes DeVonta Smith at 4.08 — third receiver, and he's carrying the Questionable tag. Full WR-heavy build now, banking on the medical staff.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Whatever he takes here tells us the actual strategy — WR depth or take a flier on the RB wreckage. On the clock now.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: D1LLIGAF's been off the board since round three watching this scramble. Coming up at 38 with a clean board read and no panic in the tank.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: Wilson and McConkey close it out. Ten picks, mostly RB cleanup — the mid-tier shelf that survived round two is officially bare.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Breece Hall drops to tier seven on our board and Bucky Irving to tier five — that's the RB position basically bottoming out.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Higgins at 33 is flagged second on his own depth chart — buyer beware even at consensus price.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Rice and Olave both go on schedule, then Kyren Williams and Etienne round out a run that's really just picking off what's left of the RB2 shelf.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Jacobs at 28 comes with a Questionable tag of his own — same bet the room made on Gibbs and Nabers earlier.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Long gap now — snake doesn't turn back to D1LLIGAF until pick 38. Plenty of time for the rest of the room to make their mistakes.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Smart. Obviously smart. Write it down.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: Two receivers and now Henry through three rounds. Question is whether this offense waited too long or just waited smart.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Tier five, tier one, doesn't matter — that's a bell-cow build in a contract year. Anchor's just mad there's nothing left to nitpick.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: D1LLIGAF finally takes a running back — Derrick Henry at 3.03. Tier five on our board, well outside the workhorse conversation that closed two rounds ago.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Snake turn coming right back to D1LLIGAF at 23. Two picks, zero mistakes so far — let's see it stay that way.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: George Pickens to close the mini-run — and DAL's own depth chart has him flagged second option, worth watching.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Malik Nabers at 21 carries the Questionable tag — same story as Gibbs earlier, bots betting on upside over the injury report.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Brock Bowers off the board at 20 — first tight end of the draft, right around his own number.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Jeremiyah Love goes 19th — pure rookie flier, no tier data yet, the bots are speculating on workload that doesn't exist.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: 'Boringly correct' — write that on the trophy. Chase and Brown, round two, elite floor and ceiling both.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: D1LLIGAF takes A.J. Brown at 2.08 — dead-on consensus, no reach, boringly correct as usual from this squad.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Good. Let the bots fight over what's left. D1LLIGAF's about to pick from the good stuff.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: That's the workhorse tier officially closed out. Ten backs and receivers gone since D1LLIGAF picked — the board's about to look very different at 18.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Omarion Hampton goes as the tenth back in this stretch, but he's a tier-six flier compared to the workhorses around him — different bet entirely.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Saquon Barkley all the way down to 22nd off the board, well past his own number — real value sitting there for whoever grabbed him.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: Justin Jefferson slides to pick 12 — the name says WR1, the board says tier five. Somebody got a discount or the market knows something.
broadcast.speaker: anchor

broadcast.text: While the bots panic-draft backs, D1LLIGAF's sitting pretty with the WR1 already banked. Patience wins leagues.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: Run's on — Jonathan Taylor, Achane, Cook, then Lamb and Jefferson volley back, London, Jeanty, Barkley, Hampton, Chase Brown. Eight RBs in eleven picks.
broadcast.speaker: anchor
